audit.skip_reason: Services offline — static mode only; no dynamic reports generated

escalations.title: Handlebars.js Multiple Critical JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.8)
cves: GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q (CVSS 9.8, RCE via AST type confusion)
escalations.exploit_scenario: If test infrastructure is compromised (supply chain attack on ts-jest), or if custom Handlebars templates are compiled with untrusted input, remote code execution is possible in the Backend dev/test environment. Risk escalates if Backend test containers are part of the deployed CI/CD image.
escalations.impact: Remote Code Execution in test environment; prototype pollution; process crash/DoS
escalations.immediate_action: cd Source/Backend && npm update ts-jest && npm audit fix
escalations.architecture_fix: Replace ts-jest with @swc/jest to eliminate handlebars entirely

p1_findings.title: Primary Domain Spec Entirely Untraced — 74 Requirements at 0% Coverage
p1_findings.detail: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md (FR-001–FR-069) is listed as domain truth in CLAUDE.md but has zero // Verifies: FR-0XX traces in any source file. The codebase implements the workflow engine spec instead, with no deprecation notice on the old spec.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Not externally exploitable. Governance risk: any agent or developer reading CLAUDE.md is directed to a spec that describes a completely different system, causing spec drift to compound indefinitely.
p1_findings.impact: All agents operating on this codebase believe they are building to a spec that was never implemented. Compliance, feature completeness, and audit reports against this spec are meaningless.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add a deprecation header to Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md pointing to workflow-engine.md, OR move file to Specifications/_archived/. Then add formal FR-IDs to workflow-engine.md.

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Targets Wrong Spec — Emits False PASS
p1_findings.detail: The enforcer uses a 'most recently modified requirements.md' heuristic, currently targeting Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (100% traced). It never checks Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md. Every agent in every pipeline receives a false PASSED signal.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Not externally exploitable. Pipeline integrity risk: verification gate is non-functional for 74 domain requirements.
p1_findings.impact: All pipeline agents have been given false green on traceability. Any audit relying on python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py is meaningless for the primary spec.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to also scan Specifications/ for FR-IDs (or run with --file Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md as a second invocation). Must be fixed before QO-001 can be verified as resolved.

p2_findings.title: Business Logic in Route Handlers — Service Layer Bypassed
p2_findings.detail: approve, reject, dispatch handlers each perform state-machine transition validation, change history construction, and direct store writes. Architecture rule violated: No direct DB calls from route handlers; Business logic has no framework imports.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract approveWorkItem(), rejectWorkItem(), dispatchWorkItem() into Source/Backend/src/services/workflow.ts. Route handlers: validate input → call service → return result.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search Not Wired — Tests Falsely Satisfy FR-dependency-search
p2_findings.detail: search.test.ts lines 3-6 explicitly state the route is NOT wired into app.ts. Tests return 404 in practice. Frontend searchItems() API client points to the missing route. Traceability enforcer counts this as satisfying FR-dependency-search.
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement GET /api/search?q= route and wire it into app.ts, OR mark FR-dependency-search as explicitly deferred.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate Diverged Frontend Test Files — Hidden Failures Risk
p2_findings.detail: Two test files per component. Older root-level files have incomplete mocks. Both run in CI, inflating counts without reliable signal.
p2_findings.recommendation: Delete the four older root-level test files. Verify no unique cases before deletion.

p2_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in Optimized Deps .map Handling
p2_findings.detail: Vite ≤6.4.1 allows path traversal in optimized deps .map file handling. Attacker could access .map files outside intended directory, potentially leaking source code or .env contents.
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite && npm run build (verify production build passes)

p2_findings.title: esbuild Dev Server CORS Bypass — Cross-Origin Request Leakage
p2_findings.detail: Any website can make requests to esbuild dev server and read responses. Sensitive data in dev server responses (API responses, build artifacts) exposed cross-origin.
p2_findings.recommendation: Resolved by npm update vite (updates esbuild transitively). [CROSS-REF: DEP-002, DEP-004]

p2_findings.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style> in CSS Output
p2_findings.detail: If CSS includes user-controlled strings, unescaped HTML tags in PostCSS output enable XSS.
p2_findings.recommendation: Resolved by npm update vite (updates postcss transitively). [CROSS-REF: DEP-002, DEP-003]

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-* Requirements Reference Non-Existent Spec IDs (FR-070–FR-085)
p3_findings.recommendation: Add FR-070–FR-085 to Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md (or replacement spec), OR update plan to mark requirements as standalone.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line in Production Frontend Source (2 instances)
p3_findings.recommendation: Review each suppression. Document with inline comment if suppression is intentional, or fix the dep array if not.

p3_findings.title: Hardcoded localhost:4200 URL in DebugPortalPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallback. Throw config error if VITE_PORTAL_URL is unset, or disable page in non-dev builds.

p3_findings.title: Domain Type BlockerRef Defined Inline in UI Component
p3_findings.recommendation: Move BlockerRef to Source/Shared/types/workflow.ts referencing WorkItemType enum.

p3_findings.title: workflow-engine.md Spec Has No Formal FR-IDs
p3_findings.recommendation: Add Formal Requirements section embedding or referencing FR-WF-XXX IDs from Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md.

p3_findings.title: brace-expansion Zero-Step Sequence DoS
p3_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm audit fix (auto-resolves this transitive dep)

p4_findings.title: 22+ Backend Test Cases Missing // Verifies: Comments
p4_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-WF-XXX or // Verifies: FR-dependency-XXX to each unlinked test case.

p4_findings.title: E2E Test Suite Not Implemented
p4_findings.detail: test script is 'exit 1'. No Playwright test specs exist despite playwright.config.ts being present.
p4_findings.recommendation: Implement smoke tests: create work item → route → assess → approve → dispatch.
